title: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes
blurb: Trained a latent-variable generative model with ordinary backpropagation by maximising a lower bound on the likelihood and rewriting the sampling step so gradients pass through it.
intro: An encoder maps each input to a Gaussian over latents, a decoder maps a latent back to a distribution over inputs, and the loss is the negative evidence lower bound: reconstruction error plus the KL divergence from the encoder's Gaussian to the prior. Sampling $z = \mu + \sigma\epsilon$ with fixed noise $\epsilon$ makes the whole thing differentiable. The steps build the autoencoder, the reparameterised sample, the closed-form KL and the reconstruction loss; the capstone runs one full training step with gradients derived by hand.
